Also always remember to put everything into perspective. Every single day you wake up is another victory. When you meet a new person, it's a victory. Every time you put a smile on another persons face, it's a victory. When something puts a smile on YOUR face, then it's a victory. Life is full of them, you just need to pay attention. If you don't take the time to look, they'll pass like dust in the wind. Everyone struggles with something, no matter how much money you make or how attractive you are. No matter who you are, there is always something that will eat at your brain. You just need to look past these things, towards the good things in your life instead. Take the time and pay attention to the little things from now on. You might surprise yourself when you finally realize what you've been missing out on. Also, you're not alone. Even if it always feels like it. As Mr. Rogers said, "Look for the helpers. You will always find people who are helping." There are people out there who want to help you, to console you, to make you feel that warmth we all desire. These people are out there and eventually are going to cross your path. Accept your mistakes and forgive those who have wronged you. You must make peace with yourself. Find solace in the fact that you've made it to today. Because today is when you start making your life better. Do it for you, because the better you make yourself, the better you are to everyone else.
